analysis: The two units are base-side excerpts (lines 1243-1617) of CHANGELOG.md, which is documentation only. The patch for this PR changes only lines 11-39, which retitle the release candidate to v0.10.10 and add upgrade notes about waitlists for `darkbloom waitlist`, new sandbox setup and new pair setup. The supplied base text does not contain the changed region, so I could not examine the new lines directly beyond the truncated patch excerpt. No code, configuration or behavior change is visible in the supplied evidence. The base text describes earlier cluster, tenant-scoped prefix cache (T-041 related), SSD tier and cluster-local features, none of which this PR modifies in the supplied evidence. The waitlist notes imply a new coordinator-side approval gate for new sandbox and new pair setup. Its enforcement lives in code outside the supplied batch, and the excerpt is truncated at "If the coordinator does not offer waitlists yet, both new setups go on as in 0.". That fallback may let new sandbox and pair setup proceed without approval, which is intended policy but unverified here. Neither the gate nor the fallback is reviewable from this evidence, so I record it as an unverified contract rather than a finding. The next pass should check the actual code implementing the waitlist gate and fallback if it appears in other batches. Related surfaces are TB-013 and T-061 for the sandbox installer, and the TB-011 coordinator authorization boundary. No security regression is established from these units.
